direction: Compact, legible, keyboard-first. Keep Pi theme roles and numbered choice markers; align wrapped text under its first line. Use small range indicators instead of explanatory subtitles. No additional animation or idle work.
architecture: Extend the existing JS/Pi modal and semantic choice controller, not a second TUI or choice state machine. Presentation owns only scroll offsets, focus and expanded view; keyboard, external adapters and selection still settle through the existing input bus. Local UI preference is separate from managed startup settings. RPC/AHP retain complete text and unchanged settlement semantics.

requirements.contract: /choice on/off changes only this session's active interactive_choice tool membership and execution admission. Off cancels pending choices and suspends force-at-end without changing its preference. Existing AHP provider registration is stable; stale completions and delayed UI work cannot cross enablement generations. Runtime settings are not persisted.

Native PCM is cached in RAM per open choice; repeated and in-flight requests reuse synthesis, navigation cancels stale playback only, close/mute cancels fills. 16 MiB/32 entry bound; no disk fallback or cross-choice reuse. Opaque command providers are explicitly uncached.

PI_INCOGNITO suppresses shared speech queue admission, speech feed and image archive creation, and Cacophony/AHP publishing even with individual opt-in flags. Private UI preferences remain in memory. Explicit model/audio/profile endpoints and user tools are not sandboxed.

Default placement is a bottom-anchored dock using at most half the terminal and 18 rows, without blank padding for short content. Transcript remains visible. f toggles opt-in fullscreen independently of text expansion; placement is persisted locally and mouse coordinates follow the rendered dock offset.
Expanded view wraps the complete question, option headline, distinct label and description, preserving explicit line breaks and graphemes. Every rendered line fits its terminal-cell width.

Question text uses at most five rows. Each expanded choice uses at most five content rows. Long question and choice text scroll independently of selection and each other, with visible position indicators; all text including the last line is reachable.

The option list is height-bounded, follows deliberate selection changes and supports independent viewport scrolling. Resize clamps offsets and invalidates hitboxes. Tiny windows remain bounded and keyboard-operable.

Expanded view defaults on. v toggles text expansion while choosing; f toggles bottom/fullscreen. /choice view expanded|compact|bottom|fullscreen|toggle|reset shares the same setter. A bounded owner-private local preference survives new choices/sessions and preserves configured symlink indirection, without rewriting settings.json or saving question text.

Scrolling/toggling never selects, submits, speaks, resets timeouts or sends model messages. Freeform typing, PTT, numeric selection, Enter, Escape, paste handling, stop confirmation and ring/Omni/AHP arbitration keep their existing semantics.

Pure layout/controller tests plus isolated real Pi PTY keyboard, mouse and resize tests; rendered screenshots at normal/narrow/short sizes and both view modes. No production state, audio, controller, or session changes. Cached redraw p95 <10ms for a nine-choice long-text fixture, no render-time I/O or idle tasks.
